content.short: Orbit Bridge is a multi-chain bridging protocol that supports TON, enabling asset transfers across a wide range of blockchains.
content.description: Orbit Bridge is a decentralized, multi-chain communication protocol that facilitates the seamless transfer of assets and data across a vast array of blockchains, including TON. It allows users to bridge tokens from networks like Ethereum, Polygon, and Klaytn directly into the TON ecosystem. Known for its high efficiency and broad support for various token standards, Orbit Bridge enhances the multi-chain connectivity of TON, making it easier for users to interact with decentralized applications regardless of their native chain.
content.meta: Bridge assets to TON from multiple chains with Orbit Bridge. Explore cross-chain interoperability on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
